spec_family.name: New Construction Architectural Element Painting
spec_family.description: Combined prime+paint spec for standalone decorative architectural elements in new construction: exposed beams (not part of coffered ceiling systems), decorative column wraps, and fireplace mantels/surrounds. Three paintable items with distinct UOMs (LF for beams, EA for columns, EA for mantels) unified under a single spec because they share identical substrate handling, material systems, interstage process, and quality tier behavior. Each element type has its own profile/complexity modifier: beam_profile (1.0-1.40x), column_type (1.0-1.30x), mantel_type (1.0-1.50x). Mixed working heights: beams overhead (ceiling-mounted), columns full-height, mantels wall-height. Substrate-driven primer selection for bare substrates; primer conditional on substrate_state. QT-driven finish systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5). Localized protection (floor_workzone for spray, floor_perimeter for brush) — discrete elements, not room-spanning. Material systems are QT-driven recommendations — contractor retains discretion.

includes: Standalone decorative beam painting (exposed 3-sided box beams, faux timber wraps, decorative ceiling beams NOT integrated into a coffered grid)
Decorative column wrap painting (square, round, fluted, paneled — floor-to-ceiling or partial-height)
Fireplace mantel and surround painting (shelf mantels, leg/pilaster surrounds, full assemblies)
Surface prep per substrate and element type (dust removal, sanding per substrate state)
MDF edge sealing with solvent-based sealer (bare MDF only — step 1 of two-step prime)
Fastener hole filling and sanding per element type (beam LF, column EA, mantel EA)
Caulking at element-to-structure junctions (beam-ceiling, column-top/bottom, mantel-wall)
Primer coat — conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE (substrate-driven chemistry)
Finish coat application (spray or brush) — 2 coats standard, 3+ at QT5 brush per FFD SS15.10.3
Between-coat interstage process (inspect, sand per element, repair, clean) at ALL quality tiers
Floor protection (perimeter for brush, localized workzone for spray)
Wall adjacent masking when spraying near finished surfaces
Ceiling fixture masking near beam spray work

excludes.item: Coffered ceiling beams (integrated into ceiling grid system)
excludes.route_to: SF_WOOD_CEILING_NC (coffered ceiling_style covers beam faces within the grid)
Not a painting scope — masonry/tile trade

excludes.item: Stair newel posts (part of railing system)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection scrutiny, sanding discipline, repair scope, and coat count.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2 prohibited — prominent millwork per Millwork Doctrine SS6.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for primer and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Spray preferred for production speed. Brush for occupied spaces, small scope, or intricate profiles. No roll — these are millwork.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen. Constrained by quality tier gate.
Input substrate condition. Drives primer requirement and prep scope.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SS_BARE: full primer coat required (substrate-driven chemistry). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: skip primer.

configuration_dimensions.description: Beam construction/profile type. Drives beam-specific complexity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: small_box=narrow flat faces (4-6 in). standard_box=typical decorative (6-8 in). large_timber=heavy timber (10+ in). ornate=carved/detailed profile.

configuration_dimensions.description: Column construction/profile type. Drives column-specific complexity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: square_smooth=flat panel faces. square_detailed=panel with applied molding. round_smooth=turned cylinder. round_fluted=fluted with channel detail.

configuration_dimensions.description: Mantel assembly complexity. Drives mantel-specific complexity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: shelf_only=single floating shelf. standard_surround=shelf + legs/pilasters. full_assembly=elaborate surround with crown/dentil/paneling. full_assembly may not capture most complex installations — assess individually.

paintable_items.name: Decorative beam
paintable_items.counting_rules: Running LF of exposed beam length. Profile complexity (width, face count, detail) handled by beam_profile modifier. Typically 3 exposed faces (bottom + 2 sides) for ceiling-mounted beams.
paintable_items.notes: Overhead work. Height modifier applies via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND. Beam overhead factor ~0.85x baked into base production rates.

paintable_items.name: Decorative column wrap
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each column counted individually. Size and profile complexity handled by column_type modifier. Height captured via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND — columns run floor-to-ceiling or partial-height.
paintable_items.notes: Full height work. Height modifier applies — upper column requires ladder/scaffold.

paintable_items.name: Fireplace mantel/surround
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each mantel counted individually. Assembly complexity handled by mantel_type modifier.
paintable_items.notes: Standard wall height work (H1 typical). Stone/brick/tile surround is NOT in painting scope.

variants.notes: Most common NC scenario. Factory-primed, standard spray. Fastest production variant.
Factory-primed, superior spray. QT5 spray uses 2 coats.
Factory-primed, standard brush. Minimal protection — brush drip only.
Factory-primed, superior brush with gloss. 3 finish coats per FFD SS15.10.3.
Bare substrate, standard spray. Primer + 2 finish coats. Full spray protection.
Bare substrate, superior brush. Primer + 3 finish coats. 4 total coats, 3 interstage cycles. Slowest variant.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Running LF of standalone decorative beams.
Perimeter floor protection near element work areas.
Localized floor protection around spray work area.
Wall masking LF near spray target (beam-wall, column-wall, mantel-wall junctions).

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: application_method = spray AND fixtures near beam work area
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Ceiling fixture count near beam spray work.
Height modifier for beams (overhead) and columns (full-height). Mantels typically H1.

protection_zones_required.notes: Localized floor coverage around spray target. Not full room — architectural elements are discrete items. Canvas drop cloths around beam, column, and mantel work areas.
Drop cloth runners near element work areas. Brush drip protection.
Paper/film + tape masking at beam-wall, column-wall, and mantel-wall junctions. Protects finished wall surfaces from overspray. Spray only.
Ceiling fixtures near beam spray work. Tape and plastic bag over each fixture. Spray only.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Beam meets drywall ceiling along full length. Different finish — beam enamel vs ceiling flat.
Beam meets wall at end supports. Different finish — beam enamel vs wall latex.
Column top meets ceiling. Caulk joint at perimeter.
Column meets wall at back (wall-mounted). Freestanding columns have no wall adjacency.
Mantel meets wall at all contact edges. Different finish — mantel enamel vs wall latex.

valid_input_states.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. SS_BARE requires full primer (substrate-driven chemistry). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips primer.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: Unfinished wall needs no protection during brush application.
Finished walls need masking during spray to prevent overspray on completed surfaces.
Ceiling protection not needed for brush work on discrete elements below.

site_condition_rules.effect: Floor protection excluded when floor is subfloor.
site_condition_rules.notes: NC may have subfloor during architectural element painting.

site_condition_rules.effect: Temperature affects dry times and open time for waterborne products.
site_condition_rules.notes: Refer to manufacturer PDS for temperature limits.

site_condition_rules.effect: MDF edge sealing uses solvent-based products — adequate ventilation required.
Height modifier via PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND: H1=1.0x, H2=1.30x, H3=1.50x, H4=2.00x.
site_condition_rules.notes: Beams are overhead at ceiling height. Columns are full-height. Mantels are wall-height (H1 typical, usually no access constraint).

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Architectural element painting is part of the millwork/trim package in NC. Typically painted with or after trim and before wall finish. Elements may be painted in situ (ceiling-mounted beams, wall-mounted columns) or partially pre-finished.
sequencing_notes.internal_sequence: Three paintable items — can be painted in any order. Beams first (overhead, then can walk under), columns second, mantels last is a common approach. All items share the same interstage cycle.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Floor protection > Wall adjacent masking (spray) > Fixture masking (spray near beams) > Apply coats > Teardown in reverse > Vacuum.
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep per element > [MDF edge seal if bare MDF] > [Primer per element (conditional on SS_BARE)] > Interstage > Finish coat 1 per element > Interstage > Finish coat 2 per element > [QT5 brush: Interstage > Finish coat 3] > Final inspect > Cleanup

relationships.notes: Architectural element painting is part of the millwork detail package. Same crew, same material system as other millwork. Mantels are the SOURCE of COMP_FIREPLACE complexity (1.30x) for adjacent wall/ceiling specs — this spec IS the architectural element work, not affected by the modifier itself.

sections_used: SS4 — Primer Systems (MDF edge seal, FJP stain-block, hardwood tannin-block)
SS7.2 — Complexity Modifiers (adapted for beam_profile, column_type, mantel_type)
Floor Protection (localized workzone for spray, perimeter for brush)

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Dry times should be specified in specs
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: No dry times in specs — refer to product PDS.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Material system selection is mandatory doctrine
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Material systems are suggestions per QT — contractor has discretion.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC architectural element painting (Spec #16). Key features: 3 paintable items with distinct UOMs (beam LF, column EA, mantel EA), combined prime+paint with conditional primer (substrate-driven), 3 element-specific complexity modifiers (beam_profile 1.0-1.40x, column_type 1.0-1.30x, mantel_type 1.0-1.50x), 7 configuration dimensions, mixed working heights (beam overhead, column full-height, mantel wall-height), localized protection (floor_workzone, not floor_full), 4 protection zones, 39 SOP tasks across 7 modules (24 binary + 15 qt_scaled), 3 round configurations, 9 variants. All 8 material system IDs reuse existing entries. 3 proposed PaintScope keys (PS_SURFACE_LF.ARCH_BEAM, PS_SURFACE_EA.ARCH_COLUMN, PS_SURFACE_EA.ARCH_MANTEL). 18 registry additions proposed. QA: pass_with_warnings (5 minor, 0 blockers).
